title: Illustro UI-first static control inventory
mode: Source-code extracted controls, NOT runtime visibility/interactivity validation
notes: HTML-like button/input/select/textarea/summary tags are extracted from three UI construction sources only.
An element marked initially_disabled can become enabled at runtime; do not infer broken behavior from it.
Controls constructed dynamically, in other modules, and CSS visibility conditions are not comprehensively included.
Some summary tags have no fixed selector; Work should discover them in the running UI.
Use this file as a starting seed; compare with runtime DOM inventory before declaring coverage.
